name: The White Room
source:
A visual novel about a lost soul in purgatory, a hammer space riddled with timed events*, and the angel that needs her to move on in order to get his next paycheck. 

*Though they are not shown, the room menus add up to ten seconds. Be for warned.

Warning! 
This game contains an un-canon portrayal of purgatory, general bad pacing and questionable mixture of art assets. And don't forget that code! Talk about ugh-- haha!

[From [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-27/?action=preview&uid=27229]official site[/url]]

Created for [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-27/]Ludum Dare 27[/url].
translation:
一部视觉小说，讲述了炼狱中迷失的灵魂、充满定时事件*的锤子空间，以及需要她继续前进以获得下一份薪水的天使。

*虽然没有显示，但房间菜单加起来长达十秒。敬请警告。

警告！
这款游戏包含了对炼狱的非正统描绘、普遍糟糕的节奏以及令人怀疑的艺术资产混合。并且不要忘记该代码！谈论呃——哈哈！

[来自[url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-27/?action=preview&uid=27229]官方网站[/url]]

创建于[url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-27/]卢杜姆敢于27[/url]。
